description: Lists active listings for the selected visible store/channel. Use this for store-wide active listing/product questions, including most expensive products/listings, cheapest products/listings, stock checks, price ranking, source/supplier usage and other active listing aggregation. First resolve the store with hgr_list_channels, then call this tool using channelOAuthId from the selected store. For rankings, filtering and summaries, pass fields/sortBy/sortDirection/limit directly to this tool and answer from its response. For product source/supplier questions, request the source field when available; source means supplier/source marketplace. Use sourceId only to resolve visible supplier/source names. Do not use origin for source/supplier questions: origin means listing creation mechanism such as Catalog, BulkLister, WeListForYou, Extension, AI Publisher or AI Agent. The response can be a compact schema/data payload: interpret each data row by matching positions with schema; this is not an error and does not require a second pass. Public replies use visible product ids and marketplace references. Do not use this tool to construct CSV, XML, XLSX, feed or bulk export files. Requires HGRApi Header channel / ChannelOAuthId resolved internally.

channelOAuthId.description: ChannelOAuthId returned by hgr_list_channels for the selected visible store.

fields.description: Fields to return. Use projection for compact answers.

limit.description: Maximum number of rows to return. HGRApi maximum is 10000.

sortBy.description: Field used to sort before limit/pagination.

name: hgr_get_active_listings
title: Get Active Listings
